items.title: Envoy Proxy — Threading Model, Filter Pipeline & Dynamic xDS Control Planes
items.description: Complete senior principal engineering guide to Envoy Proxy, detailing its event-driven multi-threaded C++ engine, L4/L7 filter chains, dynamic streaming gRPC xDS discovery APIs, and resilience mechanisms.

items.title: Microservices Design Patterns
items.description: Comprehensive guide to microservices design patterns including API Gateway, Circuit Breaker, Service Mesh, Sidecar, Strangler Fig, Bulkhead, and service discovery in Spring Cloud.

items.title: Service Mesh
items.description: Deep-dive into Service Mesh architecture — Envoy internals, xDS API, mTLS certificate lifecycle, traffic management patterns, observability, Spring Boot integration, and production failure modes for senior engineers.
